purpose: Determine whether MLP6, MLP7, or their normalization-mediated interaction implements the MLP6--7 contribution to the Task14 MLP8 computation, while retaining embedding, attention, MLP0--3, and MLP4--5 as live causal contexts.

parent.finding: MLP6--7 was usually larger than MLP4--5 but neither half globally dominated MLP4--7. Their interaction remained substantial and direction dependent, including full-response MLP effects of -22.7% for plural-to-singular and +49.3% for singular-to-plural. Splitting MLP6--7 must therefore preserve all earlier writer families and MLP4--5 as live contexts.

novelty_audit.relation: No canonical Task14 result causally separates MLP6 from MLP7 at raw pre-MLP8 input while preserving the complete upstream interaction lattice.
Binding parent evidence. It localizes a distributed MLP4--7 contribution and licenses the prospective MLP6 versus MLP7 refinement, but contains no opened MLP6/MLP7 outcomes.
The older depth split intervened at the later pre-attention-11 current-value input rather than the raw pre-MLP8 input and did not test this child-to-parent interaction closure.
Older MLP6/7 observations concern equality or compression objects, not this Task14 causal computation through MLP8 and L11H3.

data.row_builder: unchanged fresh matched-natural Task14 HOLDOUT rows
data.disclosure: The text, native outcomes, and all parent E/A/U/W/X outcomes are open. Only the MLP6-versus-MLP7 intervention outcomes are prospective; this is a mechanistic refinement on licensed rows, not new independent data.

exact_input_partition.corner: For each subset of E,A,U,W,Y,Z, use donor values for listed families and recipient values otherwise at the raw pre-MLP8 residual state at subject position 8, then apply native MLP8 RMSNorm independently to that corner.
exact_input_partition.authoritative_same_role_grouping: Let X be the exact parent MLP6--7 aggregate and XR = X - (Y + Z) its numerical grouping remainder. If Y and Z are both recipient, use the exact recipient X; if both are donor, use the exact donor X. Only genuinely mixed Y/Z corners are constructed from their separately selected writes plus XR, with XR prospectively following Y. Same-role corners must not be reconstructed from separate Y and Z tensors.
exact_input_partition.mixed_role_grouping: For a mixed Y/Z corner, use Y_role + Z_role + XR_Y_role. The remainder assignment is numerical bookkeeping fixed before outcomes and has no semantic interpretation.
exact_input_partition.response_algebra: At each normalized corner, evaluate exact MLP8 cross, quadratic, and full response pieces using the frozen v2 float64 local polarization computation; anchor recipient and donor endpoints to native float32 MLP8 outputs, assign numerical product/output closure remainders to cross, cast once to the native intervention dtype, and propagate sequentially through native lambdas 9--11 before installing the L11H3 current-value contribution.
exact_input_partition.operational_limit: E/A/U/W/Y/Z are native writer families used as causal grouping variables. They are not claimed to be a unique semantic or gauge-fixed basis.

conditions.opposite_number: all 63 nonempty subsets of E,A,U,W,Y,Z times exact cross, quadratic, and full MLP8 response
conditions.same_number_lexical: the same complete 63-subset by three-response-piece factorial using a same-number, different-lemma source
conditions.downstream_background: one standalone fixed L11H3 interface; all other MLP4--MLP10 output slots remain recipient

causal_statistics.set_function: Compute the complete 2^6 Boolean factorial separately for direction, response piece, and endpoint, then calculate every finite Mobius interaction over E,A,U,W,Y,Z.
causal_statistics.parent_corner_map: A parent corner T over E,A,U,W,X maps to the fine corner T with X absent when parent X is recipient, and to (T without X) union {Y,Z} when parent X is donor. These authoritative same-role endpoints define the child-to-parent restriction.
causal_statistics.parent_mobius_map: For a parent coefficient not containing X, the coefficient must equal the fine coefficient on the same E/A/U/W set. For a parent coefficient R containing X, it must equal the sum of every fine coefficient Q such that Q outside {Y,Z} equals R outside {X} and Q intersects {Y,Z}. This sums the Y-only, Z-only, and YZ fine interactions, with any retained E/A/U/W context unchanged.
causal_statistics.exact_child_to_parent_lattice_closure: Under the stated corner map, reproduce all 31 nonempty parent E/A/U/W/X corners and all parent Mobius coefficients for both source roles, both number directions, all three response pieces, and both endpoints. Also check closure at raw pre-MLP8 state, normalized MLP8 input, MLP8 output, sequentially propagated slot, and installed L11H3 head contribution.
causal_statistics.primary_aggregates: Within each parent X-centered M, EM, and AM aggregate, report the signed and absolute recovery carried by Y-only, Z-only, and YZ-containing fine coefficients, retaining W and all other contextual indices rather than marginalizing them away.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_parent_closure: All registered exactness gates pass, and authoritative same-role regrouping reproduces every parent corner and parent Mobius coefficient within 5e-5.
predictions.pred_b_Z_mlp7_dominant: Disjoint Z-only refinements recover at least 70% of every parent X-centered M, EM, and AM aggregate in both endpoints and both number directions, while the corresponding disjoint Y-only and YZ-containing refinements each recover at most 25%.
predictions.pred_c_Y_mlp6_dominant: The exact converse criterion holds: disjoint Y-only refinements recover at least 70% of every parent X-centered M, EM, and AM aggregate in both endpoints and directions, while corresponding disjoint Z-only and YZ-containing refinements each recover at most 25%.
predictions.pred_d_distributed_mlp6_7: Disjoint Y-only and Z-only refinements each recover at least 25% of at least one parent X-centered aggregate in both endpoints and directions, neither child satisfies the global dominance criterion, and YZ-containing refinements remain below 25% for those aggregates.
predictions.pred_e_YZ_composition: Fine Mobius terms containing both Y and Z reach at least 25% of a parent X-centered M, EM, or AM aggregate in both endpoints and both directions.
predictions.pred_f_direction_switch: The larger of the signed Y-only and Z-only recoveries, or the sign of the YZ contribution, differs between plural-to-singular and singular-to-plural in at least one preregistered X-centered aggregate in both endpoints.
predictions.pred_g_number_specific: For every subset and response piece, the absolute same-number different-lemma effect is at most 25% of the corresponding opposite-number full-source scale in both endpoints.

opposing_alternatives.exclusive_interpretation: Predictions b and c are mutually exclusive single-child dominance alternatives because they use disjoint Y-only, Z-only, and YZ buckets. Prediction d is the additive distributed alternative when neither dominance rule holds and the YZ bucket is minor. Prediction e is the interaction-distributed alternative when the YZ bucket itself is large. Signed recovery is the sum of the stated fine Mobius coefficients divided by the signed parent coefficient; absolute recovery is reported alongside it to expose cancellation and is not substituted post hoc for the registered signed test.
opposing_alternatives.direction_dependence: Prediction f can hold with b, c, d, or e and tests a distinct directional organization rather than serving as a post-hoc rescue of a failed dominance prediction.
opposing_alternatives.null: If b--f all fail after exact closure and the lexical control passes, MLP6 versus MLP7 is an informative null at this grouping: the parent X contribution is not simply attributable to one child, a stable distribution, a large child interaction, or a direction switch under the registered bars.

batching_policy: No chunking is registered. Execute exactly one native role batch, one decomposed role batch, one native 379-condition evaluation batch, and one decomposed 379-condition intervention batch, for four physical and four logical forwards. If a pre-execution memory dry-run cannot execute this exact plan, do not open scientific outcomes; freeze a prospective engineering correction before any GPU causal run. Silent or outcome-dependent chunking invalidates the run.

price.accounting: Two 48-example role/decomposition passes plus two 6064-example native/intervention condition passes: 48 + 48 + 6064 + 6064 = 12224 evaluations; 378 non-noop conditions times 16 rows = 6048 causal interventions.
